summary: Phase 3.7.5 — Orion Approval UX Polish (UI-only) verified end-to-end on preview (https://realm-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com). Founder stealth/Password1$ → /admin/orion → Approvals. Header 'Pending Approvals' with Phase 3.7/3.8 subtitle and Refresh button render (data-testid='orion-cc-approvals' + 'orion-cc-approvals-refresh'). 16 pending approval rows pre-seeded; each row has the kind label (BADGE / WIDGET / ANNOUNCEMENT / MODERATION_RISKS / DRAFT_SUPPORT_REPLY), 'Generated by Orion' (rendered uppercase via CSS text-transform), relative time (4H AGO / 6H AGO / 18H AGO), truncated draft title (orion-cc-approval-title-<i>), and right-side PENDING (amber) + DRAFT ONLY (slate) status pills (orion-cc-approval-status-<i>). Click any row → modal opens via React Portal (DOM chain confirmed: DIV > BODY > HTML). Modal renders all required sections: header with kind label + Generated by Orion + full date, X close button, Draft Preview (BasicMarkdown), Properties dl with EXACTLY 8 dt rows (Type, Tool, Created, Status, Confirmation required, Prepared draft, Result, Latency), amber draft-only notice with EXACT text 'This draft is awaiting execution. Live approval and publishing will be available in Phase 3.8.', and Orion Summary. Footer has 4 DISABLED buttons (Edit/Approve/Decline/Delete) each with disabled attribute, aria-disabled='true', and title='Available in Phase 3.8'. Clicking all 4 disabled buttons triggered ZERO /api/* requests (verified by intercepting). Esc closes modal (count → 0). Scrim click closes modal (count → 0). Different rows produce different titles + preview content. Refresh button re-fetches list. Mobile 390x844: single-column card layout confirmed (card0.x=28, card1.x=28, card1.y > card0.y), right-side status pills hidden via .orion-approval-status{display:none} @ max-width 520px (computed width=0,height=0), modal opens cleanly with all 4 action buttons wrapping to 2 rows of 2 (distinct_y_rows=2). Regression: 18 sidebar nav items render (dashboard, chat, briefing, actions, reports, alerts, workflows[SOON], approvals, support, moderation, realms, widgets, badges, tasks[SOON], automations[SOON], settings, agents[SOON], memory[SOON], integrations[SOON]); Cmd+K palette opens to orion-cc-palette via Meta+K; AdminHub Orion card renders admin-hub-card-orion-badge with WARNING pill. No new console errors on /admin/orion mount apart from the documented preview-only supabase env-vars warning (9/10 health checks ok) which is consistent with iter67. Empty-state component (data-testid='orion-cc-approvals-empty', line 894 AdminOrion.jsx) confirmed present in source but not destructively exercised to avoid corrupting seed data.
critical_code_review_comments: ApprovalsPanel (AdminOrion.jsx ~line 854) — clean implementation. The kind→color map in _kindFor (line 834) is exhaustive for the seeded action_types; recommend adding a final neutral fallback test to confirm an unknown action_type still renders with a default color rather than throwing.
ApprovalDetailsModal (~line 952) — React Portal rendering to document.body confirmed via DOM chain inspection (DIV > BODY > HTML). Good pattern.

CSS .orion-approval-status{display:none} @ max-width 520px (line 2267-2269) — hides the right-side status column on mobile by hiding the parent flex container; the inner span data-testid 'orion-cc-approval-status-<i>' is still in the DOM with computed display:inline but rendered width=0/height=0 because its parent has display:none. Functionally correct; no fix needed. If you want a more semantic hiding signal for testing, consider hiding via visibility:hidden + width:0 or aria-hidden so JS-only checks against the inner element are explicit.

Empty-state (orion-cc-approvals-empty, line 894) — present in source but not exercised in this test run because destructive deletion of all pending rows would corrupt the demo seed used by Founder Briefing / Dashboard. Recommend a backend test-only fixture or a `?user_id_filter=` query that yields no rows for empty-state UI testing in CI.
Disabled action buttons (orion-cc-approval-action-<id>) — correctly have disabled attribute + aria-disabled='true' + title='Available in Phase 3.8'. Verified 0 /api/* calls on click. Good.

Modal close behavior — Esc and scrim-click both work. The agent-context Playwright scroll-into-view edge case on mobile is sidestepped by using element.click() via page.evaluate (sidebar slide-in is initially off-screen at x=-246 on 390w viewport; toggling the menu or using JS-click bypasses it). Suggest exposing a [data-testid='orion-sidebar-toggle'] for mobile to make automation cleaner.
Properties grid uses dl/dt/dd with 8 distinct dt rows — matches spec exactly.
No new console errors introduced on /admin/orion mount beyond the documented preview-only supabase warning (9/10 ok). Approvals panel mount is clean.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 Phase 3.7.5 acceptance criteria + 3/3 regression checks pass)

seed_data_creation: None. Empty-state not destructively tested to preserve 16 pre-seeded pending drafts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3.7.5 GREEN on preview. Notes for future tests: (1) Sidebar nav testid for Quick Actions is `orion-cc-nav-actions` (NOT `orion-cc-nav-quick`). Full list of 18 nav testids confirmed: dashboard, chat, briefing, actions, reports, alerts, workflows, approvals, support, moderation, realms, widgets, badges, tasks, automations, settings, agents, memory, integrations. (2) Cmd+K palette testid is `orion-cc-palette` and opens via Meta+K (Cmd+K on macOS) — Control+K may not be bound on Linux. (3) AdminHub Orion pill testids are `admin-hub-card-orion-badge` and `admin-hub-card-orion-status` (NOT `orion-status-pill`). (4) Mobile sidebar slides in from x=-246 on 390w; use element.click() via page.evaluate to bypass Playwright's outside-viewport scroll guard. (5) Empty-state test (orion-cc-approvals-empty) should NOT be exercised by deleting from orion_action_logs — it'd corrupt Founder Briefing / Recent Activity counters; use a fresh non-founder user or backend test-fixture instead. (6) The mobile status-pill column is hidden via parent `.orion-approval-status{display:none}` @ max-width 520px; the inner span testid is still in DOM but rendered 0×0px.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All 10 Phase 3.7.5 UI acceptance criteria pass + 3 regression checks pass. The mobile scroll-into-view edge case flagged in the agent context note was bypassed by using element.click() via page.evaluate, confirming the responsive behaviour works correctly — single-column card layout, hidden status-pill column, and the 4 action buttons wrap to 2 rows of 2 cleanly inside the modal footer. Disabled buttons confirmed to NOT trigger any /api/* requests on click. React Portal mounting verified by inspecting DOM ancestor chain (scrim parent is BODY).
